evidence.sourceExcerpt: CRAN: Package fedmatch fedmatch: Fast, Flexible, and User-Friendly Record Linkage Methods Provides a flexible set of tools for matching two un-linked data sets. 'fedmatch' allows for three ways to match data: exact matches, fuzzy matches, and multi-variable matches. It also allows an easy combination of these three matches via the tier matching function.
